request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-14T09:20:00+02:00:
Vorige week zijn er ineens zwarte plekken onderaan de douchewand gekomen. Volgens mij lekt de douche achter de tegels. Ik wil de schimmel laten verwijderen en de tegels laten vervangen.

Repair estimate lines:
- PLB-PIPE-REPAIR: Lek achter tegels herstellen (age on estimate: not stated)
- MOULD-REMEDIATION: Schimmel verwijderen (age on estimate: not stated)
- TILE-WALL-REPL: Wandtegels douche vervangen (age on estimate: not stated)

loss_date.quote: Vorige week zijn er ineens zwarte plekken onderaan de douchewand gekomen.

what_happened.value: Black spots suddenly appeared at the bottom of the shower wall; customer thinks the shower leaks behind the tiles
what_happened.quote: Volgens mij lekt de douche achter de tegels.

source.quote: Volgens mij lekt de douche achter de tegels.

location.value: bottom of the shower wall in the shower

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date is approximate: 'last week' resolved to one week before the message date (2026-10-07), the exact day is unknown. Leak cause is the customer's assumption. No info on whether the leak is stopped, or on item ages.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports black mould spots on the bottom of the shower wall, suspects a leak behind the tiles, and wants the mould removed and the tiles replaced.
